analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($375.02) vs SMA5/20/50($385.46/$416.42/$431.36): Below short/mid-term trends, diagnosed as bearish position.
· Position vs SMA100/200($426.98/$400.03): Below long-term trends, indicating bearish strength.
· 52-week position (49.0%) + Current price range is historically neutral.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (26.5→36.1) + Attempting to exit oversold + Weak rebound amidst ongoing downtrend.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6.3282→-6.3282) + Worsening maintained + Weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $371.37) + Bandwidth at 21.63%, approaching the lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($372.72) + Basis (Near lower BB, Pivot S1).
· Swing Resistance ($380.00) + Potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) + Lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.03x) + Moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Conditions for entry: RSI recovers above 45 and MACD histogram turns positive.
